displayName: SafeRoute staging: database is not up

documentation.content:
The Cloud SQL instance reported that it is not up for 5 minutes. If you stopped it on purpose to save money, disable this policy first (runbook, section "Stopping the database on purpose").

What to do: docs/runbooks/alerts-staging.md, section "When an alert arrives". Do not paste project ids, URLs or tokens when asking for help.
